title: Artificial Intelligence Powered Retail: Revolutionizing Customer Experience for a Sustainable Future
description: A guide to AI in retail — personalisation, inventory optimisation, sustainable supply chains, and how intelligent systems are transforming the customer experience.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in Retail, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Retail for retail operators, ecommerce teams, merchandisers, and readers tracking customer experience.
